title: Similar incursions at Norfolk Naval Base and over DC
place_text: Norfolk Naval Base, Virginia; Washington, DC

tellings.quote: they had similar incursions at uh, Norphick, um, the Norfick Naval Base,

plain: Unknown objects also intruded over Norfolk Naval Base in Virginia and over Washington, DC, much like the ones Navy fighter pilots reported near their own training areas. The Navy fighter pilot Ryan Graves tells Michels this as something he heard from others, and if true it would mean the intrusions were reaching some of the most sensitive military airspace in the country.
